decisions.reason: The signature-insertion requirement is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Easy signature insertion in the current Canva document does not change the deferred requirement for a modular future-proposal template.
Canva signature insertion does not alter the requirement that proposal hyperlinks remain functional.
The signature-insertion decision does not change the PDF format, email submission method, or clean-export requirement.
The ability to insert a signature in Canva does not change the requirement for a print-ready PDF.
Signature insertion is unrelated to incorporating the four team biographies or retaining biography placeholders.
The signature-insertion requirement does not change the selected Agua Arc brand identity, logo, or color sources.
The source message's separate photo-relocation instruction is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the signature-insertion change adds no further photo-state change.
The Canva signature-insertion decision does not affect inclusion or replacement of proposal tables.
Signature insertion in the proposal letter does not alter the fixed RFQ section order.
The client requests signature editability for the letter but does not change the full-document layout strategy or graphic-treatment requirements.
The signature-insertion decision does not resolve or alter required narrative sections, including the existing uncertainty about Section 6.
